messages:
ryan: Spike notes: dedicated-pool saturation still causes big tail. Idea: "admit gateway" in front of pool that makes a <=1ms decision to allow, probe, or redirect to fallback.

tess: Sounds right. Need per-tenant policy + control-plane overrides. Also avoid retry stampede.

omar: Proposal: three-state circuit per-pool: CLOSED/PROBING/OPEN. In PROBING allow small fraction (configurable) via deterministic hash buckets; in OPEN redirect according to tenant policy.

ryan: config sketch:
`admit_gateway: trigger_p95_ms:250 probe_frac:0.03 probe_secs:15 open_min_secs:45 buckets:64 fallback_order:[private_quant,hosted_api,enqueue]`

tess: Make fallback_order overridable per-tenant and enforce denylists from control plane. Also emit a short decision code in trace/span (e.g., AG01_POOL_OPEN -> routed(hosted_api)).

omar: Add per-path health scoring. If hosted_api returns 5xx too often, mark it degraded for penalty_secs and skip. Also support enqueue-with-retry as a softer alternative returning 202+retry-after.

devops-bot: deploy: Canary admit-gateway:v1 on pool-eu-central at 1717777850 :rocket:

ryan: Next steps: Tess will spec control-plane API for per-tenant flags, I'll draft RFC for runtime decision API, Omar will prototype hash-stagger algorithm. Ops please add dashboards: admit_rate, fallback_rate, probe_accept_rate, fallback_latency_by_path.

tess: Agreed. Keep runtime decision local for latency; control plane provides signed policy blobs. We'll also add a PASS_THROUGH fallback for emergency rollback. :thumbsup:
